_note: Slide 13/17: agent.pace_cv, the coefficient of variation of inter-call gaps - the field that fired in March. Ingest processors are stateless per document, so a script here CANNOT keep a 10-call window keyed on agent.id the way slide 17 implies. What actually works: the collector carries the last N inter-call gaps on the span as agent.recent_gaps_ms, this script reduces them to a single float, and the array is dropped again before the document is written. See docs/SLIDE-VS-REALITY.md for the Data Prepper alternative that does hold state.

script.source: if (ctx.agent == null) { return; } def gaps = ctx.agent.recent_gaps_ms; if (gaps == null || gaps.size() < 3) { return; } double sum = 0.0; int n = 0; for (def g : gaps) { sum += ((Number) g).doubleValue(); n++; } double mean = sum / n; if (mean <= 0) { return; } double sq = 0.0; for (def g : gaps) { double d = ((Number) g).doubleValue() - mean; sq += d * d; } double sd = Math.sqrt(sq / n); ctx.agent.pace_cv = sd / mean; ctx.agent.tool_rate = 60000.0 / mean;
